made-in-china.com: 50. The gap: the https redirect.

Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.

Lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.

pneusgom.re: 38. The gap: HSTS.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.

Lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
